description: Constructor standings entries with season-to-date points equal to 6.0 are included in the filter.

c.request: For each race (`constructorStandings.raceId`), using only constructor standings entries whose season-to-date points (`constructorStandings.points`) clear the 6.0-point threshold, compute the average season-to-date points and the average season-to-date win count (`constructorStandings.wins`), ignoring missing values (an average is missing if there are none). Then take the overall average of these per-race average wins across all races, again ignoring missing values; return nothing if that overall average is missing. List the race ID, average points, average wins, and the race's average wins minus the overall average. Show the 10 races with the largest difference first (missing differences last), without rounding. Constructor standings entries with season-to-date points equal to 6.0 are included in the filter.
c.sql: WITH race_averages AS (SELECT raceId, AVG(points) AS avg_points, AVG(wins) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings WHERE points >= 6.0 GROUP BY raceId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS overall_avg_wins FROM race_averages) SELECT ra.raceId, ra.avg_points, ra.avg_wins, ra.avg_wins - o.overall_avg_wins AS win_difference FROM race_averages AS ra CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.overall_avg_wins IS NOT NULL ORDER BY win_difference IS NULL, win_difference DESC LIMIT 10

b.request: For each race, average the nonmissing season-to-date points and win counts of constructor standings entries with points ≥ 6.0; subtract the overall average of the nonmissing per-race win averages from each race’s win average, return no rows if that overall average is missing, and show the 10 races with the largest difference first, missing differences last, with race ID and unrounded averages and difference.
b.sql: WITH race_averages AS (SELECT r.raceId, AVG(cs.points) AS avg_points, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins FROM races AS r LEFT JOIN constructorStandings AS cs ON cs.raceId = r.raceId AND cs.points >= 6.0 GROUP BY r.raceId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS avg_race_wins FROM race_averages) SELECT ra.raceId, ra.avg_points, ra.avg_wins, ra.avg_wins - o.avg_race_wins AS win_difference FROM race_averages AS ra CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.avg_race_wins IS NOT NULL ORDER BY win_difference IS NULL, win_difference DESC LIMIT 10
b.raw: For each race, average the nonmissing season-to-date points and win counts of constructor standings entries with points ≥ 6.0; subtract the overall average of the nonmissing per-race win averages from each race’s win average, return no rows if that overall average is missing, and show the 10 races with the largest difference first, missing differences last, with race ID and unrounded averages and difference.

d.request: For each race ID, include constructor standings entries with season-to-date points of at least 6.0; average their nonmissing points and wins separately, then subtract the overall average of all nonmissing per-race average wins from each race’s average wins. Return the 10 races with the largest difference first, placing missing differences last, with no rounding; return no rows if the overall average is missing.
d.sql: WITH race_averages AS (SELECT r.raceId, AVG(cs.points) AS avg_points, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins FROM races AS r LEFT JOIN constructorStandings AS cs ON cs.raceId = r.raceId AND cs.points >= 6.0 GROUP BY r.raceId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS overall_avg_wins FROM race_averages) SELECT ra.raceId, ra.avg_points, ra.avg_wins, ra.avg_wins - o.overall_avg_wins AS difference FROM race_averages AS ra CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.overall_avg_wins IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference IS NULL, difference DESC LIMIT 10;

a.request: For each race (`constructorStandings.raceId`), using only constructor standings entries whose season-to-date points (`constructorStandings.points`) are at least 6.0, compute the average season-to-date points and the average season-to-date win count (`constructorStandings.wins`), ignoring missing values (an average is missing if there are none). Then take the overall average of these per-race average wins across all races, again ignoring missing values; return nothing if that overall average is missing. List the race ID, average points, average wins, and the race's average wins minus the overall average. Show the 10 races with the largest difference first (missing differences last), without rounding.
a.sql: WITH race_averages AS (SELECT raceId, AVG(CASE WHEN points >= 6.0 THEN points END) AS avg_points, AVG(CASE WHEN points >= 6.0 THEN wins END) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings GROUP BY raceId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS overall_avg_wins FROM race_averages) SELECT raceId, avg_points, avg_wins, avg_wins - overall_avg_wins AS wins_difference FROM race_averages CROSS JOIN overall WHERE overall_avg_wins IS NOT NULL ORDER BY wins_difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
